title: Stereo Pants
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Armor piece |type = [[Leggings]] |rarity = e |collection = Sponge VII |lore = Plays sweet tunes that you and people nearby can hear! |defense = +35 |treasure_chance = +1 |enchantable = yes |reforgeable = yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 2 |museum_category = fishing |color = 04cfd3 |sell = 1000 |raw_materials = *120 Sponge *4 Prismarine Shard |mat_cost_bazaar = *4 Enchanted Sponge *4 Prismarine Shard |id = MUSIC_PANTS }} '''Stereo Pants''' are an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] piece unlocked at {{Coll|Sponge|VII}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Sponge VII}} |A1 = Enchanted Sponge |B1 = Enchanted Sponge |C1 = Enchanted Sponge |A2 = Prismarine Shard |B2 = |C2 = Prismarine Shard |A3 = Prismarine Shard |B3 = |C3 = Prismarine Shard |Output = Stereo Pants }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Leggings |name = Stereo Pants |rarity = e |treasure_chance = 1% |defense = 35 |item_ability_name = Beat Saver |item_ability_description = While worn, grants a small chance to catch [[Music Discs|{{Green|Music Discs}}]] while fishing. }} '''Stereo Pants''' give {{Stat|Treasure Chance|+1}} as well as a {{Green|3%}} {{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1549110504666955947 |user=mrkeith |date=09/14/26, 1:32 PM (EST) |text= 
what's the chance for a music disc catch?
3 in 100 
are there preconditions like rolling a treasure catch?
no 
and does it overwrite the catch, roll only if a normal treasure catch failed, or can you get both normal treasure & a music disc from a single catch?
it looks as if it completely overrides the catch}} chance to replace any catch (including [[Sea Creatures]]) with vanilla [[Vanilla Objects/Music Discs|Music Disc]]. When worn, '''Stereo Pants''' also play music through [[Note Block]] sound effects. The song played is selected at random. To change the song or reactivate the pants, the player needs to take off the pants and then put them back on, or switch lobbies. == Game Messages == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Condition ! Message |- | class="ct" | If standing near spawnpoint | {{Dialogue|&7Your &5Stereo Pants &7will start playing when you leave spawn!}} |- | class="ct" | Fishing up a music disk | {{Dialogue|&b&l♪ MUSICAL CATCH! &r&fYou caught a &aMusic Disc - [disc name]&f!}} |} == Songs == * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cKlMBgTWV38 ''Nyny''] - A cover of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EEjq8ZoyXuQ ''New York, New York''] by Frank Sinatra, but at a faster tempo. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QojXPfxdD5Y ''Pump it Up''] - An original composition made by Hyperdron for the 2015 note block contest, originally called [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xBnpziWYQT4 ''Pumped Up!'']. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_bXH-UV8jYM ''Flowering Nights''] - A cover of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wFRIWFraWQ Sakuya's battle theme of the same name] from ''Touhou 9: Phantasmagoria of Flower View.'' * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFOaOZgcuHc ''Chased by Creeper''] - A cover of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9mf72VqoO0 ''Fly Above Hatoyama at Night''], from ''Perfect Memento in Strict Sense'', an album complementing a ''Touhou Project'' book of the same name. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OY_hwvHmIf0 ''Gamemode8''] - A cover of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y-ZCqMnfuBc ''Leaf Ponders the Flower, Flower Ponders the Leaf''], the theme of a fan-made stage in ''Touhou 11: Subterranean Animism''. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gc2pm9xZXO0 ''Original''] - An original composition made by MusicByPedro, first used as the pregame lobby theme of Turbo Kart Racers. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=py18VsyTyNg ''Red House''] - A cover of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0FRm11igVnI ''Magician's Melancholy'']. * Moonrvg – Build Battle OST * Walking Mega – Build Battle OST == Trivia == * The songs played on the '''Stereo Pants''' are also available in housing for {{Rank|VIP}} and above. * The '''Stereo Pants''' are a reference to the Hypixel Pit item, which has the same songs. * The ability name ''Beat Saver'' could be a reference to the VR video game ''[[W:Beat Saber|Beat Saber]]''. * For treasure catches, if you would normally get {{Stat|treasure chance|16.1{{Overline|6}}}} or higher without it, the additional bonus from '''Stereo Pants''' will not grant more treasure catches compared to {{Id|Abyssal Leggings}} when accounting for the odds of fishing up a music disc instead. == Bugs == * Music discs caught via this item's ability does not get deleted by {{Item|Personal Deletor}}s == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Mar 12|Moved recipe unlock from {{Coll|Sponge|V}} to {{Coll|Sponge|VII}}.|Added {{Stat|Treasure Chance|+1}}.|Added {{AN|Beat Saver}} ability.}} {{History|2026/Jan 20|Stereo Pants music discs no longer count as a treasure catch, and now give a custom message when fished up instead.}} |beta= {{History|0.5|[[File:Stereo Pants.png|26px]] Added '''Stereo Pants'''.}} {{History|0.22|Moved recipe unlock from {{Coll|Sponge|V}} to {{Coll|Sponge|VII}}.|Added {{Stat|Treasure Chance|+1}}.|Added {{AN|Beat Saver}} ability.}} {{History|0.24.1|Stereo Pants music discs no longer count as a treasure catch, and now give a custom message when fished up instead.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Sponge}} {{Nav/Armors}} [[Category:Leggings]]
